verdict.rationale: Manufact ships an official CLI that builds and runs MCP servers locally and deploys the current project to Manufact Cloud, and it manages servers, deployments and environment variables from the terminal. That covers the build-and-push core of the story. The evidence does not show a CLI login or authentication command; API keys are documented only for REST, CI and scripts. Installing servers into agents is documented only as dashboard one-click installs or copy-paste config, not as a CLI step. Missing for 10: documented CLI authentication command, CLI-driven install into agents/clients, detailed CLI build/stage docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents

citations.quote: build and run MCP servers locally, deploy them to Manufact Cloud, and manage servers, deployments, and environment variables without leaving the terminal.
Deploys the current project to Manufact Cloud.
